label: Client
notes: Central person entity in Acute. Source identifier is the client URI, for example /clients/123. Reads are executed in 7-day windows. On retry, the same window start is retried with 4-day and then 1-day windows.

label: Organisation
notes: Company master entity for TTH organisation clients. The listed GET endpoint does not expose a modified-after filter in the current spec.

label: Employer
notes: Source bridge between Client and Organisation. Employer.clientId refers to the id part inside Client.client. The listed GET endpoint does not expose a modified-after filter in the current spec.

label: Invoice
notes: MF-issued outbound sales invoice sourced from the ledger endpoint. Payer is identified by payerClientId or payerOrgId. Reads are executed in date windows using startDate and endDate. The invoice handler also extracts and persists invoiceEvent rows from the same source response.

label: InvoiceEvent
notes: Preferred analytical billed service line entity sourced from Ledger.events[]. Reads follow the same explicit invoice windows as the parent invoice sync.

label: Personnel
notes: MF staff and professionals, not patients and not employer employees. The listed GET endpoint does not expose a modified-after filter in the current spec.
